claims.head: Good looks against hopeful ones
claims.body: The Penguins are one of the league’s best for shot quality, at the dangerous end; the Jets are one of the league’s worst, at the hopeful end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Penguins and the Jets sit at opposite ends for shot quality.
claims.call: The Penguins’ shots are more dangerous on average than the Jets’.

claims.head: The Penguins get in close; the Jets shoot from distance
claims.body: On shots from in close, Pittsburgh is the league’s best and Winnipeg is around the middle of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.

PIT.head: Pittsburgh has a lot going for them
PIT.body: Pittsburgh has had more of the chances over recent games, Winnipeg is playing for the second night in a row, and Pittsburgh has home ice. Winnipeg’s way back in is a penalty kill that holds up.

WPG.head: A tough matchup for Winnipeg
WPG.body: Pittsburgh has had more of the chances over recent games, Winnipeg is playing for the second night in a row, and Pittsburgh has home ice. Winnipeg can pull it off if their penalty kill holds up.
